@sentry/react-native.reason: Keep the Sentry 8 integration and its native crash symbol configuration.

react.reason: Keep React aligned with React DOM and the test renderer for the React Native 0.87 runtime.

react-dom.reason: Match React 19.3.0 for the web application.

react-native.reason: React Native 0.87 migration with exact-version Expo native and Metro backports in scripts/expo-native-compat.mjs; this dependency set has its own 1.8.7 binary/runtime.

react-native-gesture-handler.reason: Gesture Handler 3.3 supports the React Native 0.87 integration.

react-native-reanimated.reason: Reanimated 4.7 and Worklets 0.13 support React Native 0.87; the Expo server runtime uses the upstream inert animation-frame fallback during rendering.

react-native-safe-area-context.reason: Retain the current native safe-area integration.

react-native-screens.reason: Retain the current Screens 4 integration with Expo Router.

react-native-webview.reason: Retain the current WebView 14 player integration.

react-native-worklets.reason: Pair Worklets 0.13 with Reanimated 4.7 and React Native 0.87; server rendering uses the upstream Expo animation-frame fallback.

@babel/core.reason: Babel 8 compiles test fixtures. Expo and the Worklets plugin retain their scoped Babel 7 toolchain until those upstream packages support Babel 8.

typescript.reason: TypeScript 7 checks application and crash-reporting types. ESLint keeps its supported scoped TypeScript 6 parser, and test fixtures use Babel instead of the removed compiler API.
